HEART REFERENCE MODEL
Human Reference Atlas / HuBMAP, Visible Human Male heart. CCF release v1.3.
Based on Visible Human data from the U.S. National Library of Medicine.
https://humanatlas.io/3d-reference-library
https://github.com/hubmapconsortium/ccf-releases/blob/main/v1.3/models/VH_M_Heart.glb
CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Adaptations: rendering colours, centring/scaling and optional viewing transforms. Original geometry retained.

VASCULAR REFERENCE MODEL
BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International.
https://dbarchive.biosciencedbc.jp/en/bodyparts3d/lic.html
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Optimised source geometry: https://github.com/ashemag/human-atlas/tree/main/public/models
Source adaptation: coordinate conversion, mesh simplification and packed binary representation.
Jiki adaptation: extracted heart-region structures, cropped long vessels, grouped coronary branches, recoloured display. No anatomical registration between the HRA and BodyParts3D reference subjects is claimed.

The two reference datasets are shown separately. The wall-layer view is an original teaching schematic with exaggerated thicknesses and spacing.
